goal: A single durable, queryable human-review queue lists every unit that could not be auto-recovered, each carrying its task/run identity and a machine-readable reason, built by extending the existing orchestrator/domain event ledger and status read rather than a new silo.

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims.py -- orchestrator event ledger (acquired/stolen/renewed/released/expired), record_graph_snapshot, the existing queryable surface to extend
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/events.py -- DomainEvent / LandingParked (park_kind, detail), list_domain_events(run_id): the existing durable stop-record surface the queue reads
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_orchestrator_claims.py -- keep green; the orchestrator-event ledger regression oracle
references: .flywheel/specs/00069-FEATURE-work-redriver.md -- criterion #12; the queue is the shared invariant every routing layer writes to
constraints: Extend the existing orchestrator-event / domain-event ledger and status read; do NOT introduce a new persistence silo table for the queue (criterion #12 grades that no new silo is added)
Each queue entry exposes a machine-readable `reason` field plus the task/run identity; later routing layers (escalation, landing, prereq, no-progress, human-gate) all write this same shape
Provide one read that returns the full queue across all routed kinds
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify files under packages/*/tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions
Do not auto-clear or transition any stop here -- this layer only defines the surface and the read
edge_cases: An empty queue returns an empty list, not an error
A reason must be machine-readable (a stable token), not only a free-text detail string
